notes: FIXED_T2 protocol (2026-10-10): the reward-matrix method with Prompt Optimization OFF (p0_fixed, canonical P0), at most two Agent turns (rollout.rounds 2: tree depth, Agent replies, the Doctor's 'turn k of at most N' and the checkpoint evaluator), 120 training cases in batches of 5, and two engineering fixes: deterministic reuse of identical full scorer requests (judges.scorer_request_cache) and per-response scorer/gate audit records. Sampling, G, halting settings, rubric/feedback/witness/scoring semantics and GRPO are those of the reward matrix. The three arms differ only in reward weights.
